[[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[Link]] |gametype=4on4 |size=Large |download=https://gfx.quakeworld.nu/details/620/dust2qw/ }} Dust2qw (dust2qw.bsp) is a 4on4 Team Deathmatch map created in 2023 by [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[QurneL]], [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[xstephx]] and [[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[Link]] .
The original Counter-Strike map is one of five Counter-Strike maps that the mappers of [[The Wizard's Manse]] are creating/converting. ===Items=== {{MapItems |quad=1 |ring= |pent=1 |hp100=2 |ra= |ya=3 |ga= |lg= |rl=2 |gl=2 |sng=2 |ng= |ssg=2 }} ==Gallery== Dust2_01.png Dust2_02.png Dust2_03.png Dust2_04.png Dust2_05.png Dust2_06.png Dust2_07.png Dust2_08.png Dust2_09.png ==Layout== The quakeworld version of Dust2 is smaller in size than the original; some areas are like the original but some paths/ways/rooms are cut down for faster gameplay. Pent area is obviously something new/tricky that offers a pent fight we dont have yet in 4on4.

==Strategy & Tactics== With a 2 RL map without LG, those areas will probably be primary and secondary. The Quad will be the item to get and as usual the Pent can turn any game around. The map offers fast gameplay and a variety of tactics. 2 GL's and 2 SNG's should not be underestimated. ===Download=== You can download the map with LOCation and LIT files [https://gfx.quakeworld.nu/details/620/dust2qw/ HERE] __NOTOC__
